mapper.select: SELECT p.thumbnail, p.name, rv.rv_price, rv.rv_date, rv.rv_time, rv.rv_option1, rv.rv_option2, rv.rv_created_at FROM reserve rv JOIN place p ON p.pno = rv.pno WHERE rv.uno = #{uno} ORDER BY rv.rvno DESC OFFSET #{start} ROWS FETCH NEXT 3 ROWS ONLY
SELECT CEIL(COUNT(*)/3.0) FROM reserve rv WHERE rv.uno = #{uno}
